messages:
Emma Chen: quick heads-up — final POC readout prep for MeridianBank tomorrow 10am PT. I posted the metrics draft below, please review and flag any blockers.

Raj Patel: on it. can we confirm the ask from procurement re: dedicated capacity pricing? they want a 12-month committed quote and OBO on burst.

Emma Chen: yes they asked for committed pricing. Ben, can you draft a 12-month proposed commit with a burst clause? keep the unit economics visible. :memo: 

Ben Kline: will do. question — do we include a trial discount on the first 3 months or credit against commit? leaning credit so it converts. thoughts?

Luca Moretti: from SE side — performance numbers: median latency 92ms, p95 210ms, throughput 85 reqs/s on a 4-GPU pool (A100 equiv). KV cache hit ~42%.

Luca Moretti: evals: prompt set (30 cases) avg F1 0.78, target 0.82. main failure mode is entity recall on long-context prompts.

Emma Chen: pasted draft metrics:
```
- Latency: median 92ms, p95 210ms
- Throughput: 85 reqs/s
- Cost: $0.012 / 1k tokens (hosted baseline)
- Quality: eval F1 0.78 vs target 0.82
- Cache hit: 42%
- Error rate: 0.6% (transient GPU OOMs during burst tests)
```

Maria Gomez: security update — SQ completed except for two items: (1) encryption at rest key rotation policy (they asked for KMS rotation cadence) and (2) SOC attestation timeline for Dedicated. I have proposed language for (1). For (2) we can provide our SOC2 Type II report but Dedicated deployment requires a short statement on isolation controls.

Raj Patel: can we confirm who owns the SOC attestation reply? procurement is pushing on that to clear legal.

Maria Gomez: I'll draft the dedicated isolation statement and loop in compliance. ETA EOD today.

Luca Moretti: mitigation proposal for recall gap: (a) add a targeted prompt template that forces canonicalization, (b) enable prefix KV caching for user profile tokens, (c) small reranker step for top-5 candidates. Quick sim shows reranker improves recall from 0.78 -> 0.81 on the test set.

Emma Chen: good — include the reranker option in the readout as a near-term fix and roadmap item for model tuning.

Ben Kline: pricing — I'll prepare (A) 12mo commit w/ 20% discount vs hosted list, (B) burst at list price with 5% cap over commit for first 3 months. Share a spreadsheet in this thread when ready.

Raj Patel: also note SLA ask — they want 99.9% availability on Dedicated. Is that in scope for the initial contract or an add-on?

Maria Gomez: SLA can be included as an enterprise add-on. legal prefers it as an explicit schedule with remedies. I'll flag that in the security/compliance packet.

Emma Chen: action items:
- Maria: deliver SQ answers + isolation statement (EOD)
- Ben: pricing spreadsheet + commit proposal (EOD)
- Luca: short note with reranker sims + prompt template to include in readout (by 3pm PT)
- Raj: confirm attendee list for tomorrow readout and client success KPIs to ask for

Raj Patel: sending calendar invite now. attendees: MeridianBank (POC lead, infra, procurement), Emma, Ben, Luca, Maria, me.

Luca Moretti: note for readout slide: include one "failure example" with input, model output, and reranker result — customers like concrete before/after.

Emma Chen: perfect. If no one flags anything major by 2pm I'll post final slide pack. thanks all :raised_hands: 

Ben Kline: looks good. I'll upload the pricing sheet in the thread when done.

Maria Gomez: uploaded draft SQ answers to the shared drive and linked in the calendar invite. Ping me if anything needs stronger language.

Raj Patel: thanks team — let's aim to close procurement questions in the readout and push for a PoC-to-commit decision within 30 days.

Emma Chen: agreed. endthread.
